[[File:FrellaFish.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Frella fish skeleton]]
'''Frella fish''' were a species of fish that was a popular export. They were often transported in [[cold crate]]s to preserve freshness. On one occasion, [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] used a crate of frella fish to smuggle [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] spice onto [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].

The crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' once purchased a very large frella fish on [[Rion/Legends|Rion]]. [[Mezgraf]] roasted it for consumption.
